title: Unrequited Love
statement: The task is to count unordered pairs of key-disjoint triads (keys x, x+2, x+4, with value a_x + a_{x+2} - a_{x+4}) that have equal value, with n up to 2·10^5. Two triads conflict only when their starts differ by 2 or 4, so the count is equal-value pairs from a hash map of value frequencies minus those few overlapping adjacent pairs.
